topic: The Fed prints trillions — who tracks the trillions

script.text: In one single year... the Federal Reserve created nearly six trillion dollars. Not with printing presses. With a keystroke.
No gold moved. No trucks rolled. Digital credit... written into existence. Overnight.
So who decided this? Who watched it happen? And who... carries the bill?
Trillion dollar flows, watched by the few who have access. Wall Street sees them first. You see... the price.
Inflation is not bad luck. It is the cost of money... created while you slept.
Watch the money. Whoever tracks the trillions... understands tomorrow. Follow.
